title.narrative: Improved access to basic infrastructure and services in targeted communities

comment.narrative:
<p><strong>Fully achieved and/or Exceeded.</strong>  The level of achievement per sub-targets per type of investments is as follows:</p>

<p>(<strong>a) Road access: 100 percent of the target achieved.</strong>  A total of 129 communities have improved their access through tertiary roads which has enabled<em> 3 additional months of road access per year</em>. Out of the 129 subprojects under this typology, 70 percent are investments in road improvement; 18 percent in vehicular bridges; 7.5 percent in pedestrian bridges; 4 percent in road bumps; and 3 percent in retaining walls. </p>

<p><strong>(b) Hectares irrigated: 187 percent of the target achieved. </strong>???????Investments of 488 community subprojects translated into 2,611 hectares with ne or improved irrigation (<em>the target was 1,400 ha</em>).
